row:
Hey Horse Lovers! If you love equestrian life, horse training, trail rides, auctions, and adventures then you found the right channel. My name is Shae and I own a little piece of heaven called Free Spirit Farm. My passion in life is working with horses from all different walks of life and revitalizing them through equine wellness, training, and care. I created this channel to spread awareness about what goes on not only as an equestrian farm owner, but also as a trainer, instructor, and entrepreneur. In my videos I try to be open and transparent about horse life both the good and the bad. I truly dedicate all of my time to my horses, training, riding program, and my farm. Take a look inside look at what I do by subscribing to my channel! As always, enjoy the ride!

Merch coming soon 🔥
